end.summary:
Practised identifying quadrants from ordered pairs.
Read x as the first coordinate and y as the second.
Explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points.
Plotted points by moving horizontally for x and vertically for y.
Explained that changing only x from negative to positive moves a point from Quadrant II to Quadrant I.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading and plotting ordered pairs, identifying quadrants from the signs, and explaining why reversing coordinates gives a different point. They clearly used the method of moving right/left for x and up/down for y, and explained the Quadrant II to Quadrant I sign change. At home, ask them to plot a few pairs such as (−3, 2), (3, −2), and (−3, −2), then name each quadrant.
